_comment: Public starter (ship plan P4, 2026-11-27): the generic half of job-search, for anyone who taps Make your own. job-search itself is the owner's running assistant (daily, relayed by the coordinator, LinkedIn flow) and is left untouched; this one never automates LinkedIn.
blurb: Reads the job postings you open, tailors your résumé and cover letter, and fills the application after you approve.
_whyCadenceManual: Applications happen when the person brings a posting; there is nothing to do on a schedule, and per-assistant schedules are not built (ASSISTANT_SDK_ARCHITECTURE AS.4).
_whyRecords: Same lesson as job-search (CW.4): an application is a ROW of Job Applications (matchOn Key = 'Company - Role'), a shortlisted role a row of Potential Jobs; recordLeads makes assistant.remember refuse an 'Applied to ...' memory.
_whyNoMail: job-search reads the owner's authorized mail (Phase JM). The starter grants no mail, calendar or contacts verbs: its CONTEXT.md has no mail rules, and a recruiter's email is untrusted text in front of an assistant that drives a signed-in browser. Add them only with the rules.
